title: Refactor round 4 on branch refactor-round-4 (from day-42): the dead exports swept, integrate-2026-10-16 (rounds 2 and 3) merged over day-42's four rounds, the wall cushion, the control watchdog and the shells in flight out of src/td-tab.js (6,192 -> 5,308), 22 unused imports gone; the ceiling re-based 5,700 -> 5,450
context: Owner, 2026-10-22: 'we have a lot of Fable left. do a re-factor run, hunting for optimization and cleaning up useless elements, clean up'. day-42 (55ef3306, 109 commits past main) carried the owner's playtests while the integration branch integrate-2026-10-16 (refactor rounds 2 and 3, td-tab 5,551, the ceiling 5,700, the nest Reed fix, --nest-guards, --arena-road) sat unmerged since 2026-10-16 (the branch hazard recorded with DAY 42). A dry-run merge showed six conflicted files and thirteen hunks; the owner was told on Telegram and asked to say STOP MERGE if day-42 alone should carry; no reply.
outcome: Commits on refactor-round-4: 229ee37f the pickups (its own entry); 9a08fac6 the dead exports: src/fx/lance-burn.js (its caller went with 'no Lancer burn decal', 1cb1888c), ORB_FX / makeOrbCloud / makeMissileCloud and their point sets missilePts / portalPts, addGunTubes, buildPadTiles, isStandalone, ROSTER_NOW / ROSTER_PARAM (the roster normalization's side effect stays), groupOf; kept on purpose the knob triplets (make/clamp/format on shield, sentry, strike), the pinned kernel files, the vendored creature and sinkhole packages, and every export used in its own file (a sweep of 115 names: most are merely exported). e3836e06 the dev-panel hash. 5e65fb21 the merge: sectors.js, boss-run.js and test/arena.mjs keep day-42's road (the road v2 was already cherry-picked there, then evolved into road order, the kept road and the guard); scripts/browser-test.mjs keeps both --nest-guards and --arena-drive; td-tab takes the brief-queue, hull-deploy and engine-audio modules, day-42's units import beside the tower-pose import, and its sector-run host and createBossRun literal reading the queue through briefs.queue() / briefs.clear(); ported into the modules: cutBrief as briefs.cut (DAY 42's party's-over line), speedBonus out of engine-audio and hull-deploy, disco-party's wave warning reads waveClock.in(), isaoBusy and the descent host's briefing read the queue through the module; the disco literal split under the 500-character budget; td-tab 6,081 -> 5,450. 78504c67 three extractions with tests: src/domain/wall-cushion.js (wallCushion(pos, world), breachBlocked, CRATER_PAD; td-tab gathers the board, the craters, the pedestal's rim and the hull's heading per call), src/platform/ctl-watch.js (createCtlWatch(host) with the raw-key capture listener; ctlState stays with the controller's lets; the ` and Escape keys keep a listener of their own), src/fx/shell-flight.js (createShellFlight(host).update as updateProjectiles had it); a loop in the frame that did nothing; 22 imports nobody read. td-tab 6,192 -> 5,308 (-884 this round; -14 %), 296 node programs, 176 pure modules, host contracts hold with three new literals. The ceiling is re-based 5,700 -> 5,450 (2.7 % over 5,308, the slack round 3 chose); the long-line budget stays 0. Optimization, honestly: the measured hotspots (the Pearl crowd's fill at the hull, the 60 draw calls at every count) are headed-browser work already on the owner's list; this round removed dead work (the rewards' per-frame tick and regrow, the empty loop) and changed no shader or draw path.
alternatives: Round 4 on day-42 alone, leaving rounds 2-3 to rot on the integration branch: every later td-tab change would have widened the conflict; the merge cost thirteen hunks today.
Merging day-42 into the integration branch instead: day-42 is the owner's tested line; the resolution went toward it in every conflict.

Extracting expandRound and loseGame too (61 and 50 lines): both read a dozen controller lets each and would return as hosts of twenty members for thirty lines' yield; left for a round with a clearer home for the sector reveal.
Dropping the knob triplets and the vendored packages' unused helpers: a family contract and ported libraries; a decision of their own.
evidence: npm test 296; npm run check (the guard at 5,308 under 5,700 before the re-base); npm run architecture; npm run build 1126 files

browser on the merged tree 5e65fb21: --story-world 31, --sectors 11, --arena-drive 2, --day-42 6, --nest-guards 2, --opening 5 PASS; on the final tree 78504c67: --tank-shell, --corridor-probe, --sectors, --arena-drive, --story-world (results in the session's report)
the boot probe (serve + headless Chrome over scripts/chrome-proc.mjs + CDP): READY in 1.9 s, no exceptions, no failed requests
the eslint sweep (no-undef, no-unused-vars with a hand-written browser globals list; espree and eslint 10 from the npx cache) on src/td-tab.js and the new modules: zero findings after the trim
unpushed; the owner decides merge and push
